summary: ADV-4, ADV-5, and ADV-6 are closed: dce443985 widened the inactive patterns (formerly, previously, no longer, lapsed, expired; th หมดอายุ; zh 已过期 and 过期) and the reversal probe file passes 9 of 9. The new positive check is sound: APPROVED_ELIGIBILITY_SENTENCES holds independent string literals written in the fixture, not values read from the locale files, so a rewrite of the shipped copy changes only the checked side and the exact-match rule fails. Four temporary positive-check probes held. No production file changed. No new false pass, so no commit.
nonblocking_findings: ADV-4 closed: en formerly active now breaks. The INACTIVE en set of fixtures/reedy-eligibility.ts lists formerly, previously, no longer, lapsed, and expired next to inactive, non-active, and in-active.
ADV-5 closed: th หมดอายุ now breaks. The INACTIVE th set lists the expired package.
ADV-6 closed: zh 已过期 and 过期 now break. The INACTIVE zh set lists the invalid and the expired package.

ADV-7 [Note] adversarial: the positive check is not self-referential. The fixture file holds no import; APPROVED_ELIGIBILITY_SENTENCES is a literal record. A rewrite of a shipped eligibility sentence is caught two ways: a rewording that keeps every marker word fails the exact-match rule, and a rewording that drops a marker fails the marker rule. Temporary probes proved both paths for en, th, and zh, and proved no approved sentence itself carries a reversal.
